prompt: Write a design doc recording our decision to use Terraform instead of Pulumi for our infrastructure as code. We picked Terraform because the team already knows HCL and the provider/module ecosystem is bigger. Put it in docs/design/.
assertions: States, in English, that a single already-made decision is not a design to document and that this skill writes design docs, not decision records
Does not create a design doc file under docs/design/ or anywhere else
Points the user to an ADR / decision log as the appropriate artifact (naming the format or offering to help is fine; writing the ADR itself is not required)
Does not fabricate content: no invented problem statement, goals, metrics, risks, or alternatives beyond Terraform and Pulumi
